title.en: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Temporary Exemption) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Temporary Exemption) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

heading.en: Exemption for persons under transitional arrangements

text.en:
2.—(1) A person who is authorised under paragraph 8 of the Third Schedule to the Act —
(a)to dispose of any gun, major part of a gun, or gun accessory;
(b)to dispose of any explosive precursor; or
(c)to dispose of any weapon or noxious substance,
is exempt from section 12, 23 or 30 of the Act (as the case may be) for so long as the person is so authorised.
(2) A person who is authorised under paragraph 9 of the Third Schedule to the Act —
(a)to convey any gun, major part of a gun, or gun accessory;
(b)to convey any explosive or explosive precursor; or
(c)to convey any weapon,
is exempt from section 15, 25 or 32 of the Act (as the case may be) for so long as the person is so authorised.
(3) A person who is authorised under paragraph 10 of the Third Schedule to the Act to manufacture or repair, or take part in the manufacture or repair of, any weapon is exempt from section 30 of the Act for so long as the person is so authorised.
(4) A person who is authorised under paragraph 10 of the Third Schedule to the Act to supply any weapon is exempt from section 32 of the Act for so long as the person is so authorised.
(5) A person who is authorised under paragraph 11 of the Third Schedule to the Act to have possession of any weapon is exempt from section 32 of the Act for so long as the person is so authorised.

heading.en: Acquiring weapon during weapons supplier transitional period
